source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
Whenever an enemy unit finishes a Charge, Normal, Advance or **Fall Back move** in range of one of your controlled objective markers, roll a D6: on a 2+, the unit takes D3 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)**.

Your **ANHRATHE** units have **Void Thieves**: if such a unit is in range of a marker you control as any phase ends, that marker stays yours until a phase ends with your opponent holding a greater **Level of Control** there than you.

grants.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 3 of 73 ability grants of Detachment rules (every record of the class not withheld otherwise, each time) wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
